title: devops-rag-assistant values
description: Validated by helm lint / helm template / helm install, so a chart that would reference a mutable or empty image tag fails before it reaches a cluster.

image.description: image.tag must be a non-empty, pinned reference. :latest is mutable and exists only for demos and the CI kind job; the template also refuses to render without a tag (belt and braces).

tag.description: Pin an immutable tag (a CI-pushed commit sha) for any real deployment.
